sentences.text: Long ago, in the year 1212, something strange happened.
Many children and young people wanted to go on a journey.
This journey is now known as the Children’s Crusade.
They wanted to travel to Jerusalem.
Jerusalem was a very important city for Christians.
These young people believed they could bring peace.
They thought their pure hearts could change the world.
A boy named Nicholas was one leader.
He lived in Germany.
Another leader was a boy from France.
Thousands of children started walking.
They walked for many days.
They did not have cars or trains.
They only had their feet.
The journey was very hard.
They had little food.
They did not always have water.
Some people helped them.
But many people did not.
The children faced many problems.
Some got sick.
Some got lost.
Some went home.
The journey was longer than they thought.
Many children did not reach Jerusalem.
Some stopped in different cities.
Others tried to go home.
Some children were sold as slaves.
This was a very sad time.
The Children’s Crusade did not bring peace.
It showed how hard life could be.
It also showed that even young people can have big ideas.
Today, we still talk about the Children’s Crusade.
It is a story about hope.
It is also a story about disappointment.
We can learn from this story.
We can learn about the past.
We can remember the children who wanted to make the world better.
Even though they did not succeed, their story is still important.
It reminds us that even young people can dream of peace.
